protocol: Seven alternating fresh-Node cold/warm pairs per BlurHash/LQIP strategy; 24 pinned Kodak photos, explicit 288/384/480px WebPq75 fitinside,72byte-identical emitted images per build. Delete tool caches before every cold build, keep caches for immediate fresh-process warm build, OS cache unflushed. buildMs includes plugin loading and Vite build, common Vite/Svelte imports outside timer. processWallMs includes process startup and output validation. Native concurrency uses tool defaults. Full preview JSON equality is separately gated by run.ts; LQIP is an unchanged control. Suites serial.
